# jChat
## Warcraft chat mod, since 2019

## License
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL-blue)](https://github.com/jlelz/jChat/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Why
- Because relevant chat alerts bring chat to a whole new level 
- ...reading chat is time-consuming
- ..there is a lot of spam

## How
Interface > Addons UI

## Platforms
Currently only testing retail. It may work for classic or not

## Issues
https://github.com/jlelz/jChat/issues
